slides.title: They went home. Now they fled again.
slides.body: Addis Standard, citing the UN, Nov 4, 2026

slides.title: Returnees uprooted in NW Tigray
slides.body: The UN says families who had recently returned to Tahtay Adiyabo district have been forced to flee again amid renewed fighting.

slides.title: people had returned to six Tigray woredas
slides.body: 12,155 households, incl. Tahtay Adiyabo, as reported by Addis Standard in October 2025.

slides.title: Thousands displaced in Shire and Debre Birhan
slides.body: Debre Birhan in Amhara already hosts people displaced from West Shewa, East Wollega and West Wollega in Oromia.

slides.title: Roads restricted, aid disrupted
slides.body: Insecurity limits movement on roads linking Gonder with Debark and Metema, the UN says. It has not given a breakdown of the newly displaced.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Keep aid routes open.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica, Nov 4, 2026
